name: Barbarian
desc: Rage, resilience, and the primal connection to something older than civilization. Barbarians turn fury into damage and damage into more fury.

name: Monk
desc: Disciplined mastery of the body as a weapon. Monks channel ki into martial arts, swift movement, and impossible feats.

name: Wizard
desc: Scholars of the arcane. Wizards learn spells through study, preserve them in a spellbook, and prepare them each day.

name: Cleric
desc: Servants of a divine power. Clerics channel their god's will through prayer, healing, and the Channel Divinity feature.

name: Rogue
desc: Shadow-walkers, lockpickers, and sudden knives in the dark. Rogues trade raw power for precision and versatility.
